function.name: geology_get_era
function.description: Get the estimated date of a geological era. Unlike history_get_event_date, which gets the date of a historical event, this gets the estimated date of a geological era.

era_name.description: The name of the geological era. e.g Ice age

calculate_years_ago.description: True if years ago is to be calculated. False by default

function.name: history_get_event_date
function.description: Get the date of an historical event. Unlike geology_get_era, which gets the estimated date of a geological era, this gets the date of a historical event.

calculate_years_ago.description: True if years ago is to be calculated. False by default
